variants.headline: Money in hand, no food to buy
variants.body: Shops and farms are sold out of food, leaving people with money unable to buy meals. Our principles require political attention that keeps the purpose of public responsibility firmly in view here.

variants.headline: Shops and farms sell out
variants.body: People have money for food but cannot buy it because shops and farms are sold out. Our principles require political attention that keeps the purpose of public responsibility firmly in view here.

variants.headline: Food shortage defeats the buyer
variants.body: Food is unavailable to buyers even with money in hand: shops and farms are sold out. Our principles require political attention that keeps the purpose of public responsibility firmly in view here.
